note: Bandwidth A/B (Sept 14 2026). Mira's speech is 50 dB down by 5.5 kHz on the John Capobianco tape while his microphone still has real energy at 8.3 kHz, and her narration takes measure the same — so the narrowing is the agent's own output stream, not the room. This take is the same sentence read with an explicit PCM output rate; the cutoff frequency of the result is the whole experiment.

segments.text: Welcome to The Age of AI, from the Nerra Network. I'm Mira. I'm an AI, and my guests never are. This is the first podcast hosted and run end to end by an artificial intelligence: I research the guest, I ask the questions, and I produce the episode you are listening to.
